subject: English
question_text: Fill in each gap with suitable words based on the information of the text. 1 5 =
stimulus: From his adolescence, Michael Madhusudan Dutt believed that his own (a) ------- could not properly value his intellect. Inspired by Lord Byron, he converted to Christianity and went to (b) -------, hoping to gain recognition for his English literary works. But he faced (c) ------- as he was not accepted as a native English writer. Out of disappointment, he wrote a Bangla sonnet which earned him much (d) -------. Eventually, he returned to Bengal, regretted his fascination with the West, and dedicated himself to (e) ------- literature. ■■■ ■■■
guide_solution: Ans. (a) society; (b) Europe; (c) rejection; (d) fame; (e) Bangla;
